packageRules.description: Hold the Rust toolchain at 1.95.0 by ignoring every update renovate raises for it. `rust-toolchain.toml` is the source of truth for the toolchain, but `Cargo.toml` `rust-version` is the declared MSRV, so bumping it is a compatibility change for downstream consumers rather than a routine dependency update. Per the project's release policy an MSRV bump rides a breaking release (0.4.0), never a patch. Renovate only rewrites `rust-toolchain.toml`, which leaves the pins in `Cargo.toml`, `clippy.toml` and every `dtolnay/rust-toolchain@` entry behind and fails `scripts/check_toolchain_pins.py`, so it cannot land as proposed either. Remove this rule as part of the MSRV bump when one is authorized.

A rust-toolchain bump only rewrites rust-toolchain.toml, but the same version is also pinned in Cargo.toml (rust-version), clippy.toml (msrv) and every dtolnay/rust-toolchain@ entry in .github/workflows. A partial bump silently puts CI on a different toolchain than the one it advertises, so never automerge it - update every location together and let scripts/check_toolchain_pins.py confirm.
